description: Rangers who hunt the spirits of the dead and undead.

features.name: Phantom Sense
features.description: See invisible creatures and sense undead within 60 feet.

features.name: Phantom Curse
features.description: Curse creature to take extra damage from you.

features.name: Ethereal Veil
features.description: Turn invisible in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Phantom Lord
features.description: Summon spectral creatures. Spirits attack as bonus action.
